QuestInfo.name: Thieves' Guild Errand Boy
QuestInfo.0: You find Olive in Ereve. As you argue with her about her innocence, someone shows up. \r\nSpeak with Rondo.
QuestInfo.1: Rondo says the Thieves' Guild sent him. He drags her away, despite her claims of innocence. \r\nOlive says you can talk to Neinheart in Ereve to prove she's innocent.
